dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: MCP-FUNC / MCP-PUTTYPE / MCP-WINDOW pattern typical of ORCA MCP framework

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryou koui) software – confirmation screen 2 (KID2) for medical treatment act input
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-navigation subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles button-click events on a confirmation screen (KID2), sets a flag (SPA-KID2-FLG) indicating which print/action option was chosen (e.g. prescription, medicine info, all), and then calls ORCDBMAIN to transition to the appropriate window via PUTWINDOW.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (31 copybooks) for screen layout and shared areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE ALSO construct for multi-condition dispatch
MCP framework calls (ORCDBMAIN) for window management
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP database interface
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP, decoded here as latin-1 causing mojibake in the display. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. The label 'grpsys' appearing before the CALL statement on column 1 appears to be a label or tag artifact in the source.
